definitions.explanation: A small pad of paper used for jotting down quick notes. Also refers to a simple text editor application on computers or smartphones.

examples.japanese: メモ{帳|ちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧おく。
examples.english: I'll write it down in my notepad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧メモ{帳|ちょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧。
examples.english: I bring a notepad and pen to meetings.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧メモ{帳|ちょう}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}した→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I typed my shopping list into the notepad app on my smartphone.

notes:
A compound of ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ (memo) + ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (notebook/register). Originally referred to physical paper notepads, but now also commonly used for digital notepad applications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メモ{帳|ちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in a notepad
- メモ{帳|ちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a notepad
- メモ{帳|ちょう}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: notepad app
- メモ{帳|ちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧: to carry a notepad around

USAGE:
In the digital context, メモ{帳|ちょう} is the Japanese name for Windows Notepad and is used generically for simple text-editing apps on smartphones.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧: a memo, a note (the act of jotting down or the note itself)
- ⟦{手帳|てちょう}→手帳：04537_techou⟧: planner, pocket notebook (typically with a calendar)
- ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧: notebook (larger, bound)
- ⟦{付箋|ふせん}→付箋：08245_fusen⟧: sticky note
